query: SELECT cc.nome, SUM(total) as total FROM (SELECT contaCustoId, valor as total FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002 UNION ALL SELECT contaCustoId, valor as total FROM lancamento_salario WHERE periodoCustoId = 30002) sub JOIN conta_custo cc ON sub.contaCustoId = cc.id GROUP BY cc.nome ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
